title: Reduce compact rounded-ADD residue control to linear size (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped constructive proof with exact finite corroboration: compute the signed odd residue during the compact rounded ADD's numerator rewind. The new phase has exactly `8o+2` labels and `14o+4` literal rows across both component parities. The complete graph bound changes from `O(LK+o²+Ko)` to `O(LK+Ko+o)`.

```diff
 numerator ready at its delimiter
- rewind; forward residue/power scan; rewind
+ backward signed Horner residue during one rewind
 unchanged exact quotient and low-bit discard
```

For an M-bit numerator, the replacement saves `2M+2` virtual reads, `2M+2` moves, `4M+6` executed rows and `28(M+1)` physical coded-tape actions per component. It retains both private banks, rounded semantics, cancellation, source preservation, whole-field staging and successful cleanup.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit CubeJerry / Jerry Chen's #6988 economical-graph question, #6990 compact ADD scaffold, exact Builder, lifecycle and fixtures; DreamingOfClouds' #6936 word and #6937 rounding proposal; and the full retained predecessor lineage. Horner evaluation is classical. The contribution is this source-bound smaller phase and its proof, adapter and verifier.

## Evidence

The generated table for `-1379/250` has **38,300 rows**, compared with **187,806** for the original compiler. The other two supplied coefficient fixtures remove 226 and 66 rows. These are enumerated instruction counts, not wall-time speedups. The original compiler is used as a resource comparator for the new step.

Local checks on `618ff7af4ac85c63ee2c39acc69bf763ed35b60a` passed:

- 63,240 independently interpreted signed residue executions, every width-1-through-8 bit string, both parities, and all 62 odd divisors from 3 through 125.
- 2,720 complete changed ADD calls through the retained literal lifecycle: 2,298 successes and 422 correct range rejections. Three further cancellation fixtures produce `(-80,0)`, `(-4,0)` and `(1,0)`.
- Exact graph and operation counts, identical dyadic/integral tables, two detected semantic mutants, dirty-history reuse, late whole-field overflow and subsequent reuse.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict checks produced identical generated hash-bound receipts. Each took under six seconds locally. Registered replay passed; committed-byte/source-history preflight passed for all 11 package/input files.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -X dev -B research/reverse-horner-residue/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -X dev -B research/reverse-horner-residue/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reverse-horner-residue
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/reverse-horner-residue --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may be substituted. The direct marker is `PASS_REVERSE_HORNER_RESIDUE`. Replay writes no files.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The mathematical local phase covers every positive width and finite odd divisor. The executable retains `o<=125`, bounds coefficient length by 24 and enforces finite graph caps. It authenticates four live source files and injects a private Builder into the exact named compiler definition. Runtime tables use only the existing six opcodes.

The inherited numerator, quotient, canonical-format and lifecycle contracts remain premises. Full coefficient-catalogue and recursive source binding, production installation, complete physical tariff conversion, native/outer recovery and the selected cold replay are unrun. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, complete multiplication theorem, independent human review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. The five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

- Expose a direct Builder parameter in a versioned production compiler, preserving the two entry edges, quotient continuations, source pins and lifecycle charges.
- Share power-free residue graphs across the complete coefficient catalogue while retaining exact local source tokens and recursive field delivery.

## Related open work

No open PR targeting this signed-residue prepass or compact rounded-ADD table-size quantity was found in the live targeted search. Open rounded MOVE, inverse-code recovery and tensor-extraction work concerns different operators. No numerical comparison with those packages is claimed.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `618ff7af4ac85c63ee2c39acc69bf763ed35b60a`, [run 43030221243](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43030221243), [plan job 130555044132](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43030221243/job/130555044132), failed in "Onboarding helper tests". The package `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed.

I read the checks and job log. The step ran 760 tests with 24 skipped and exactly one failure:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found in the CI verification document
FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)
```

This mismatch is present in the base main commit `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still opens with "Current selected-family replay: #6030" and names `make frontier6030-verify`. This PR changes neither file; it adds only `research/reverse-horner-residue/`.

I also read the failed logs of [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), and [run 43029932349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029932349). Each shows the same single failing test, the missing `make frontier7000-verify` assertion, 760 tests run and 24 skipped. No broader run coverage is claimed.

The verification evidence for this package remains the local normal/optimized, registered replay and committed-byte/source-history checks listed above. No fix, retrigger commit or workflow rerun was made.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package. Only the new scoped research directory changes.
